Technology and Regulation · January 2025

Unpacking Digital ID Systems' Early Policy Process: The Case of Jamaica's NIDS

with Beatriz Vasconcellos, Matthew McNaughton, Giulia Lanzuolo

Analyzes the early policy process behind Jamaica's National Identification System (NIDS), unpacking the political, legal, and administrative complexity of digital ID policy design. Conceptualizes four tensions that emerge during the process and draws lessons for more accountable, just, and inclusive ID system design. Open access.
